company.productNote: Plan types named in SBI Life’s 2025–26 integrated annual report. SBI Life is a separate listed company; State Bank of India is its largest shareholder and its branches sell most of its plans, but the bank’s own business is on its own page. The report’s photographs are advertising scenes and group portraits, so pictures are original illustrations.
